dct_description_sm: Major land uses illustrated on map 37 of the Revised Land Use and Development Plan (R.A.V.Q.1310.) Major land uses were determined by unit of assessment. For the purposes of representation, the evaluation units were merged by major allocation. The data was produced for the purpose of the final draft of the revised land use plan (map 37).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
